title: Trusted access for the next era of cyber defense
raw_excerpt: OpenAI is scaling up its Trusted Access for Cyber (TAC) program to thousands of verified individual defenders and hundreds of teams responsible for defending critical software. The company has released a variant of GPT-5.4 trained to be cyber-permissive called GPT-5.4-Cyber. OpenAI plans to make its tools as widely available as possible while preventing misuse. It will deploy its technology carefully as it continues to improve. Companies can now authenticate with OpenAI as cybersecurity defenders - those in the highest tiers will get access to GPT-5.4-Cyber.
summary: OpenAI 宣布扩大其“可信网络访问”（TAC）计划，向数千名经过验证的个人防御者和数百个负责关键软件安全的团队开放。同时，OpenAI 发布了一个名为 GPT-5.4-Cyber 的模型变体，该模型经过训练，在网络防御方面更具“许可性”。此举旨在平衡工具广泛可用性与防止滥用的需求，标志着 AI 在网络安全领域应用的重要进展。

title: Gemini Robotics ER 1.6: Enhanced Embodied Reasoning
raw_excerpt: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6 upgrades robots' embodied reasoning, improving spatial reasoning and multi-view understanding for better autonomy. It enhances visual and spatial understanding, task planning, success detection, and introduces instrument reading capabilities. Available now via the Gemini API and Google AI Studio, the model supports integration with tools like Google Search and VLAs.
summary: DeepMind 发布了 Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6，这是其具身推理模型的重大升级。新版本显著提升了空间推理和多视角理解能力，使机器人能更好地进行任务规划、成功检测，并新增了仪表读数能力。该模型现已通过 Gemini API 和 Google AI Studio 提供，并支持与 Google Search 和 VLA 等工具集成，为机器人自主性树立了新标杆。

title: Multi-Agent Kernel Optimization
raw_excerpt: Cursor detailed a multi-agent system that optimized 235 CUDA kernels for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, achieving a 38% average speedup, with some cases exceeding 2× improvements.
summary: Cursor 详细介绍了其多智能体系统如何优化了 235 个面向 NVIDIA Blackwell GPU 的 CUDA 内核，实现了平均 38% 的加速，部分案例甚至超过 2 倍。这项工作展示了多智能体协作在底层系统优化中的巨大潜力，为 AI 基础设施的性能提升提供了新思路。

title: Five hyperscalers now own over two-thirds of global AI compute
raw_excerpt: Google, Microsoft, Meta, Amazon, and Oracle now control two-thirds of the world's compute. Many AI labs depend almost entirely on these hyperscales for access to compute.
summary: Epoch AI 的最新分析显示，谷歌、微软、Meta、亚马逊和甲骨文这五家超大规模云服务商现在控制着全球超过三分之二的 AI 算力。许多 AI 实验室几乎完全依赖这些巨头获取计算资源。这一趋势凸显了 AI 算力集中化的风险，可能对行业竞争格局和创新生态产生深远影响。

title: Now in research preview: routines in Claude Code
raw_excerpt: Routines in Claude Code allow users to configure a routine once and then run it on a schedule, from an API call, or in response to an event. Routines have their own API endpoint. Webhook routines subscribe to GitHub events. Routines are available on all paid plans with Claude Code on the web enabled.
summary: Anthropic 在 Claude Code 中推出了“Routines”功能（研究预览版）。用户可配置一次例程，然后按计划、通过 API 调用或响应事件来运行。例程拥有独立的 API 端点，Webhook 例程可订阅 GitHub 事件。该功能旨在将重复性任务自动化，提升开发效率，适用于所有已启用 Claude Code 网页版的付费计划。

title: Introspective Diffusion Language Models
raw_excerpt: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer a compelling promise that parallel token generation could break the sequential bottleneck of autoregressive (AR) decoding. However, DLMs consistently lag behind AR models in quality. This gap stems from a fundamental failure of introspective consistency: AR models agree with what they generate, whereas DLMs often do not. The Introspective Diffusion Language Model (I-DLM) uses introspective strided decoding (ISD) to verify previously generated tokens while advancing new ones in the same forward pass. With gated LoRA, ISD enables bit-for-bit lossless acceleration.
summary: 本文提出 Introspective Diffusion Language Model (I-DLM)，通过内省式步进解码（ISD）在同一个前向传播中验证已生成的 token 并推进新 token，解决了扩散语言模型（DLM）质量落后于自回归模型的问题。结合门控 LoRA，I-DLM 实现了比特级无损加速，为并行生成语言模型开辟了新路径。

title: Peer-Predictive Self-Training for Language Model Reasoning
raw_excerpt:
作者: Shi Feng, Hanlin Zhang, Fan Nie, Sham Kakade, Yiling Chen
摘要: Mechanisms for continued self-improvement of language models without external supervision remain an open challenge. We propose Peer-Predictive Self-Training (PST), a label-free fine-tuning framework in which multiple language models improve collaboratively by leveraging a cross-model aggregated response as an internal training signal. Given a prompt question, the models generate responses sequentially; the final aggregated answer, often more reliable than individual responses in practice, serves as an internal target for learning. We measure how informative each intermediate response is about the aggregate using pointwise mutual information (PMI), and use this signal to scale self-training updates. Responses already aligned with the aggregate are updated less, while less informative or misaligned responses are updated more. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks (SimulEq, Math500, and MultiArith), PST improves exact-match accuracy by 2.2 to 4.3 percentage points across Gemma-2-2B, LLaMA-3.2-1B, and Qwen-2.5-1.5B, and reduces the average generator-verifier gap (GV-Gap) by 26 to 40 percent, while requiring no external supervision or teacher-student hierarchy and relying solely on cross-model interactions. These results suggest that cross-model generations and peer-predictive feedback can serve as an effective approach for self-supervised training.
summary: 研究提出 Peer-Predictive Self-Training (PST)，一种无需标签的微调框架。多个语言模型通过协作，利用跨模型聚合的响应作为内部训练信号进行自我改进。聚合答案通常比单个响应更可靠，从而作为学习目标。该方法为语言模型在无外部监督下持续自我提升提供了新机制。

title: Cram Less to Fit More: Training Data Pruning Improves Memorization of Facts
raw_excerpt: Training data pruning improves LLMs' fact memorization, reducing hallucinations and enhancing performance on knowledge-intensive tasks. By limiting facts and flattening frequency distributions, the method boosts fact accuracy to capacity limits. It enables smaller models to memorize more facts, matching the performance of significantly larger models.
summary: 苹果公司的研究表明，训练数据剪枝可以改善 LLM 的事实记忆能力，减少幻觉并提升知识密集型任务的表现。通过限制事实数量和扁平化频率分布，该方法使事实准确率达到容量极限，并让更小的模型记忆更多事实，性能可媲美显著更大的模型。

title: Event Tensor: A Unified Abstraction for Compiling Dynamic Megakernel
raw_excerpt:
作者: Hongyi Jin, Bohan Hou, Guanjie Wang, Ruihang Lai, Jinqi Chen, Zihao Ye, Yaxing Cai, Yixin Dong, Xinhao Cheng, Zhihao Zhang, Yilong Zhao, Yingyi Huang, Lijie Yang, Jinchen Jiang, Gabriele Oliaro, Jianan Ji, Xupeng Miao, Vinod Grover, Todd C. Mowry, Zhihao Jia, Tianqi Chen
摘要: Modern GPU workloads, especially large language model (LLM) inference, suffer from kernel launch overheads and coarse synchronization that limit inter-kernel parallelism. Recent megakernel techniques fuse multiple operators into a single persistent kernel to eliminate launch gaps and expose inter-kernel parallelism, but struggle to handle dynamic shapes and data-dependent computation in real workloads. We present Event Tensor, a unified compiler abstraction for dynamic megakernels. Event Tensor encodes dependencies between tiled tasks, and enables first-class support for both shape and data-dependent dynamism. Built atop this abstraction, our Event Tensor Compiler (ETC) applies static and dynamic scheduling transformations to generate high-performance persistent kernels. Evaluations show that ETC achieves state-of-the-art LLM serving latency while significantly reducing system warmup overhead.
summary: 本文提出 Event Tensor 抽象，用于编译动态 megakernel。现代 GPU 工作负载（尤其是 LLM 推理）受限于内核启动开销和粗粒度同步。Megakernel 技术通过将多个算子融合为单个持久内核来消除启动间隙并暴露内核间并行性。Event Tensor 为高效编译此类 megakernel 提供了统一方案。

title: Linear Probe Accuracy Scales with Model Size and Benefits from Multi-Layer Ensembling
raw_excerpt:
作者: Erik Nordby, Tasha Pais, Aviel Parrack
摘要: Linear probes can detect when language models produce outputs they "know" are wrong, a capability relevant to both deception and reward hacking. However, single-layer probes are fragile: the best layer varies across models and tasks, and probes fail entirely on some deception types. We show that combining probes from multiple layers into an ensemble recovers strong performance even where single-layer probes fail, improving AUROC by +29% on Insider Trading and +78% on Harm-Pressure Knowledge. Across 12 models (0.5B--176B parameters), we find probe accuracy improves with scale: ~5% AUROC per 10x parameters (R=0.81). Geometrically, deception directions rotate gradually across layers rather than appearing at one location, explaining both why single-layer probes are brittle and why multi-layer ensembles succeed.
summary: 研究发现，线性探针（linear probes）可以检测语言模型何时产生其“知道”是错误的输出，这对欺骗和奖励黑客行为检测至关重要。但单层探针脆弱，最佳层因模型和任务而异。通过集成多层探针，AUROC 在 Insider Trading 上提升 29%，在 Harm-Pressure Knowledge 上提升 78%。该研究跨越 12 个模型（0.5B-176B 参数），揭示了探针准确性与模型规模的关系。
